field.name: help
field.p: Add your first book!
Add the title, then its copies (each copy gets an accession number and barcode).

field.name: help
field.p: Add an e-book, audiobook or online resource

button.name: action_write_off
button.confirm: Write off this copy? It will no longer count in the library stock.

field.name: help
field.p: No copies yet
Every physical copy gets an accession number and barcode. Select copies and use Print > Book Labels to print barcode / QR labels.

field.name: help
field.p: Create a library card
Each member gets a card number with barcode / QR and a limit of books at a time.

field.name: help
field.p: Reserve a book
When a copy is returned it is held for the first student in the queue, who is notified.

button.name: action_mark_lost
button.confirm: Mark this book as lost? The book price is added as a fine.

field.name: help
field.p: Issue a book!

field.name: help
field.p: No circulation yet
Most borrowed books, overdue books, fines, reading by class and by month.

button.name: action_validate
button.confirm: Copies not found will be marked Missing. Continue?

field.name: scan_barcode
field.placeholder: Scan a barcode or type an accession number, then press Enter

field.name: help
field.p: Start a stock verification
Choose the racks (or the whole library), Start Count, scan every copy on the shelves, then Validate: copies not found are marked Missing.

sheet.div: Written by the student from the student portal. Staff can only hide or show a review.

field.name: help
field.p: No reviews yet
Students write their reviews themselves in the student portal (My Account > School Profiles > Library), for books they have returned.

field.name: help
field.p: Recommend a book
Recommend a book to classes or students; it appears first in their "Recommended for you".

field.name: name
field.placeholder: e.g. Summer Reading: 5 books in 30 days

field.name: help
field.p: Start a reading challenge
Set a target number of books for a period; progress updates as books are returned. Completing students can earn House Points (Reading).
